located_point.method: Site index point retained, which agrees within 25 m with the excavators' coordinate in the Shikarpur 2007-2008 report (23 deg 2' 12.00" N, 70 deg 31' 13.86" E); the 2025 article's longitude 10 km east lies outside the held 5 km imagery window. On the composite the point lies in uniform dark scrub between a stream and a salt flat; the roughly 50 m fortified enclosure was not recognised.

sources.imagery_result: no lines: the fortified enclosure, about 55 by 45 m on the plan, is not resolved in the uniform scrub around the point

notes: Plan only. The plan draws the excavation grid square to the page and the fleur-de-lis, and the fortification turned about 11 to 12 degrees anticlockwise of both. Five fortification lines, solid where excavated and dashed where traced, give theta -10.5 to -12.5. The walls of the eastern gate and the Stage 2 and Stage 3 enclosures run at other angles and were not measured.
